unavailable_fields.nvlink_bytes: NVLink per-link counters not supported: nvmlDeviceGetNvLinkState returned NVML status 3 on both devices; NCCL channels run via SHM/direct/direct and peer_access.0.1 = peer_access.1.0 = 0, so no NVLink/P2P fabric exists to measure.
unavailable_fields.pcie_bytes: Only device-wide NVML rate samples with native ~20 ms driver windows exist from the idle capability probe (390-5664 KB/s, not workload traffic); per-collective PCIe bytes cannot be derived from the logical per-rank payload (497759232 bytes counted once per collective) or memcpy sizes.
unavailable_fields.hardware_utilization: No successful hardware-counter probe; topology, NVML capability readings and logical payload do not measure hardware utilization; remains unknown.
unavailable_fields.nccl_wait_vs_wire_ms: Neither nsys timelines nor summed NCCL kernel durations separate NCCL waiting from wire transfer; the rank-0 kernel-time excess over rank 1 is strong skew evidence but not a measured wait/wire split.
unavailable_fields.gpu_readiness_and_consumer_completion: execution_timeline reports clock alignment bounds for matching CPU submissions only; GPU readiness and consumer completion of each collective may remain unknown.

plan.rationale: Objective is max-rank summed NCCL kernel duration (torch_communication.communication_kernel_sum_ms, median of 3 profiled repeats) under step_ms <= 1.05x baseline. Baseline trace: 13 DDP gradient allreduces on the final micro-batch (12 buckets of 28351488 B + final 157541376 B, fp32 SUM, world 2, bucket attribution resolved by observed gradient-storage membership); rank 0 sums 284.71 ms vs rank 1 63.41 ms, with rank-0 buckets at ~13.5 ms vs rank-1 ~3.56 ms and a 114.4 ms vs 3.6 ms first bucket, while the 157.5 MB final bucket costs ~19.5 ms on both ranks; compute overlap is only 6.84/8.26 ms. So the objective is dominated by per-collective waiting/skew plus intrinsic transfer cost over SHM/direct/direct (peer access disabled, NVLink unsupported, RING entry names observed). torch is retained as the objective and step_ms source. nccl_tuning is selected to capture the actual NCCL algorithm/protocol/channel decisions at the observed sizes/dtypes in a warmed worker, since kernel entry names alone do not establish protocol and algo/proto/channel choice is a direct lever on kernel duration. collective_calibration is selected as a correctness-checked reference experiment: a synthetic full-world SUM allreduce at the observed 28351488 B and 157541376 B fp32 sizes separates intrinsic collective cost from waiting (not a lower bound or critical-path estimate). execution_timeline is selected to attribute skew via CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization and per-device intervals with clock alignment bounds for matched CPU submissions; GPU readiness limits remain unknown. nsys is available per capability probe and is selected to resolve the cross-rank overlap/attribution questions (arrival skew behind the 114 ms first-bucket wait, comm-vs-compute interleaving on stream 17), while acknowledging nsys alone cannot separate NCCL waiting from wire transfer or prove bucket identity. Excluded: device_telemetry (device-wide NVML rates/util/memory with native windows, idle probe only, no per-collective attribution), python_runtime (host dispatch/binding not implicated; perturbs execution and its times are not performance scores), candidate_diagnostics (no capability or trace evidence ties it to these baseline attribution questions). No communication hook is replaced; bucket identity stays as observed attribution with ambiguous candidates retained.
